cases.scenario: Install the prod artifact, grant only documented permissions, start the app, and complete one foreground turn.
Send a turn, background the app, enter Doze, and verify the next poll/reconnect recovers without duplicate delivery.
Kill the app process while backgrounded and verify restart restores the durable queue and notification state.
Swipe the task away, relaunch, and verify the session resumes without losing or duplicating the pending turn.
Reboot the device and verify startup registration, notification channels, secure settings, and polling recovery.
Interrupt the relay briefly and verify reconnect, bounded retry, and exactly-once client turn correlation.
Keep the relay unavailable beyond the retry window and verify the UI exposes a recoverable offline state.
Use a controlled DNS or certificate failure and verify the client fails closed without weakening TLS or base URL policy.
Restore the relay after an outage and verify queued work drains in order and the connection becomes healthy.
Receive repeated backend notifications and verify one logical message does not produce duplicate user-visible alerts.
Deny notification, accessibility, and overlay permissions independently and verify each feature fails closed with actionable UI state.
Pause and restart the backend while the mobile app is active; verify recovery without fabricated replies or lost acknowledgements.
Run the release app against the pinned compatibility-matrix backend and verify the mobile HTTP/poll/ack contract.
Verify the documented background and battery-policy guidance on the target OEM image without treating emulator behavior as equivalent.
